notes.title: New Update Info + Some Announcements!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Pongo-ers![/b]

Have you been anxiously waiting on the edge of your seat for the next Pongo update? Well, you will have to wait no further! Here is what has been added: 

[List]
[*]Jam out to the [u]NEW original soundtrack![/u] Composed by Taylor Fredericks, Pongo now has a new groove with some fun island tunes. 

[*][i]Immerse yourself[/i] in the world of Flubber using Intel® RealSense™! Drixy Studios has partenered with Intel to add RealSense™ compatability. 

[*][u]Optimization![/u]

[*][u]Bug fixes![/u] Keep pointing out any bugs you find in the community, we are anxious to fix them!
[/list]

[b]Announcement[/b]: [u]Mac[/u] and [u]Linux[/u] support is coming [b]very[/b] soon within the next 10 days! Keep up to date on our Twitter for more updates regarding the OS compatibility update.

[b]Announcement[/b]: Soundtrack DLC (Steam Music) coming soon! 

[b]Announcement[/b]: Controller support coming soon! 

That is all for now- You can tweet to us for more suggestions at [b]@DrixyStudios[/b], or leave a constructive Steam review! 

Have a good day, and keep Pongoing!

-The Drixy Team

notes.title: Updates coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello,

You may have noticed that there have not been any updates coming up in the last month, and there is a pretty good reason for that. Our team has been working on implementing the Intel RealSense 3D technology and also the highly anticipated Controller Support!. Yes, there will (finnaly) be a controller support in Pongo. The update is going to come online probably in the following week, but not a 100% guarantee. We'll keep you updated on the situation continuously.

Read more about RealSense 3D [url=http://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/architecture-and-technology/realsense-depth-camera.html]here[/url].

Thank you,
Ermal.

notes.title: Card Drops Changes
notes.notes:
Hi,

Due to a lot of complaints by the players for the cards dropping not too frequently we've made some changes on how often they drop.

You will now get a card every 20 minutes, but that only happens after you have 2 hours of playtime on steam.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5 has been released!
notes.notes:
[h1]New Stuff:[/h1]
-Killing an enemy A.I. takes 3 seconds from the time counter/score.
-Added Achievement Stats(Deaths, Enemy Kills).

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
-Fixed some level selector bugs,
-Fixed the achievements bugs,
-Fixed the Continue Button loading the last level played bug, now the button loads the last level available.



Thank you everyone for your reports and for being part of the Pongo community.

notes.title: First-Person Pogoer: Pongo Is Out
notes.notes:
The most popular FPS of 2037 will be a fingerguns RPG hybrid where characters’ adherence to the kayfabe of imaginary Uzis, grenades, pump-action shotguns and headshots depends on your relationship with them. We can’t predict the direction the genre will go on, which weird addition or experiment will catch on then be repeated and iterated upon for years, compounding with other oddities to make something bizarre.

For now, in 2015, perhaps the answer is a pogo stick. That’s what Pongo [official site] went for. It’s out now, so you can judge for yourself whether it’s a vision of things to come.

… [visit site to read more]
